suppliers: Companies that make parts. Made-up data.
suppliers.name: Supplier company name
suppliers.country: Country of the supplier's main factory
suppliers.tier: 1 = ships straight to our plants, 2 = ships to tier-1 suppliers

parts.name: Part name
parts.component: Component group, matches the recall component
parts.supplier_id: References suppliers: the company that makes this part

part_usage: Which parts each vehicle model uses.
part_usage.model_id: The vehicle model that uses it
part_usage.qty_per_vehicle: How many of this part one vehicle needs

recall_models: Vehicle models covered by each recall.

shipments: Part shipments from suppliers to plants.
shipments.units: Number of parts in the shipment
